sentence: This project builds software course projects about identity and access management to teach cybersecurity in computing courses.
This project works on robotic tiles that join together to form paths that move material and debris on construction jobsites.
This project builds an open-source training platform that teaches life scientists advanced computing skills directly on the computing systems they use.
This project develops a way to use long-read DNA sequencing to find and track genes that give bacteria antibiotic resistance in the environment.
This project studies how a changing climate affects the symbiotic associations between microbes and their plant and animal hosts.
This project studies how differences in coral communities across an island help reefs recover after disturbance and how climate change may alter this.
This project builds a modeling framework that simulates how different testing policies might control the spread of respiratory pathogens.
This project gets a scanning transmission electron microscope to look at atomic structures of materials.
This project builds tiny devices that join single molecules with two-dimensional materials to control quantum properties.
This project builds ways to use quantum computing inside database systems to solve hard optimization problems.
This project studies how bacteria, amoeba and cancer cells move together when they travel through disordered environments.
This project uses genetic tools to find out how giant kelp populations adapt to heat stress.
This project builds quantum devices on silicon carbide chips that use light and spin qubits while keeping noise low.
This project studies the genes behind worker ants that cannot reproduce and how this sterility evolved.
This project designs a system that mixes noisy qubits with error-corrected qubits, plus software to run applications on it.
This project studies when cleaner shrimp and reef fish cooperate with each other, using field and lab experiments and mathematical modeling.
